absa-group/unify-living-documentation/17.body:
# User Story

## Description

As a user, I want to receive on-screen notifications.

## Rationale

User wants to stay informed about changes.

### Business Value

- Streamlines notifications for authorized users.

## Preconditions

- The user logged in.
- User has necessary permissions to receive notifications.

## Acceptance Criteria

| Criteria ID | State | Version | Description |
|:------:|:------:|:-------|:------------|
| `GH-17-01` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when a domain is successfully created.  |
| `GH-17-02` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when a question is successfully created. |
| `GH-17-03` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when domain is successfully modified. |
| `GH-17-04` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when access to domain successfully requested. |
| `GH-17-05` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when user successfully replied on a question. |
| `GH-17-06` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when question is marked as helpful. |
| `GH-17-07` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when question is unmarked as helpful. |
| `GH-17-08` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when data feed successfully added. |
| `GH-17-09` | Active    | v1.4.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed  when data feed edited successfully. |
| `GH-17-10` | Active    | v1.8.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed when a question is successfully deleted. |
| `GH-17-11` | Active    | v1.8.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed when a domain is successfully deleted. |
| `GH-17-12` | Active    | v1.8.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed when a data feed is successfully deleted. |
| `GH-17-13` | Active    | v1.8.2  | An on-screen notification is displayed when a domain access request is approved or rejected. |

## Connections

### Related User stories

## Change Log

| Version | Date       | Comment                          | Author |

| v1      | 2025-10-29 | proposed by| Rinah Gololo |

# User Story

## Description

As a user with valid credentials, I want to log into the Unify application.

### Business Value

- Ensures secure, controlled access.
- Prevents unauthorized access to application.

## Preconditions

- The user should be part of the PAM/dehdl group of the project.

## Acceptance Criteria

| Criteria ID | State | Version | Description |
|:------:|:------:|:-------|:------------|
| `GH-2-01` | Active    | v1.4.2   | The login screen is accessible and displays a username and password input form with a login action button. |
| `GH-2-02` | Active    | v1.4.2   | The user with valid username and password successfully logs in.  |
| `GH-2-03` | Active    | v1.4.2   | The user can log out and is redirected to the login screen.  |
| `GH-2-04` | Active    | v1.4.2   | The user with invalid username and password is prompted with error message on screen.  |
| `GH-2-05` | Active    | v2.2.7    | An authenticated user whose session has expired is redirected to the login screen with an informative message.  |
| `GH-2-06` | Active    | v2.2.7   | A user who is already logged in and navigates to the login URL is automatically redirected to the dashboard.  |
